readmeExcerpt: # OpenSEO > Open source alternative to Semrush and Ahrefs OpenSEO is an SEO tool for _the people_. If tools like Semrush or Ahrefs are too expensive or bloated, OpenSEO is a pay-as-you-go alternative that you actually control. > All-in-one SEO tool for you and your AI agent. Connect with any agent like Claude Code, OpenClaw or Hermes. We have pre-built skills, but you can build your own to tailor OpenSEO to your needs. ## Hosted Version Try OpenSEO for free on our website. If you want to support the project, a hosted subscription is $10/month. [openseo.so](https://openseo.so) ### EveryApp Host OpenSEO and other open source apps on our platform EveryApp. [Self-host on EveryApp and give it a star →](https://github.com/every-app/every-app) ## Why use OpenSEO? - Best in class MCP and AI Skills. - Modern, simple UI. - Focused workflows instead of a bloated, complex SEO suite. - No subscriptions. - Bring your own DataForSEO API key and pay only for what you use. - Fork and vibe code your own custom tool. ## Main SEO Workflows - Keyword research - Rank tracking - Competitor Insights - Backlinks - Site Audits - AI Visibility ## OpenSEO MCP & Agent Skills OpenSEO exposes an MCP server so AI agents like Claude Code, OpenClaw, and Hermes can use your SEO data directly. Agent Skills are reusable workflows that guide your agent through SEO tasks using the MCP. - [Set up ChatGPT web or desktop](https://openseo.so/docs/chatgpt) (works on Free and paid ChatGPT plans) - [Set up Codex](https://openseo.so/docs/codex-plugin) - [Set up OpenSEO MCP](https://openseo.so/docs/mcp) - [Set up OpenSEO Agent Skills](https://openseo.so/docs/skills/setup) ## Self-Hosting OpenSEO supports two self-hosting paths. Both use email and password accounts: the first visitor creates the admin account, teammates join from invitation links, and MCP clients (Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, Cursor) sign in with the same accounts. - **Docker** - On your own server or computer, with a prebuilt image that is ready in seconds. Works with Compose-based platforms such as Coolify, Portainer and Dokploy. See [`docs/SELF_HOSTING_DOCKER.md`](./docs/SELF_HOSTING_DOCKER.md). - Running the older single-container image? It keeps getting updates; [move to the new setup](./docs/SELF_HOSTING_DOCKER.md#move-from-the-old-docker-image) when you are ready, data included. - **Cloudflare** - No server to run: one deploy command puts OpenSEO on your own Cloudflare account (works on the free plan). See [`docs/SELF_HOSTING_CLOUDFLARE.md`](./docs/SELF_HOSTING_CLOUDFLARE.md). For security-conscious setups, two advanced options replace the accounts with your own network controls: - **Cloudflare Access** in front of the Cloudflare deploy, so Cloudflare checks every request before it reaches OpenSEO. See [`docs/SELF_HOSTING_CLOUDFLARE.md`](./docs/SELF_HOSTING_CLOUDFLARE.md). - **No sign-in on Docker**, behind Tailscale, a private network or your own authenticating proxy. See [Without sign-in](./docs/SELF_HOSTING_DOCKER.md#without-sign-in-advanced). Either way, you need a DataForSEO API key to get SEO data. See [`docs/DATAFORSEO_API_KEY.md`](./docs/DATAFORSEO_API_KEY.md). ## Costs OpenSEO needs a [DataForSEO](https://dataforseo.com/?aff=255379) API key so that you can get SEO data. You pay them directly when self hosting. See [openseo.so/pricing](https://openseo.so/pricing) When you self host, your costs will be slightly lower than the estimates on our website. The way the hosted service makes money is by charging 28% extra for every request we make to DataForSEO. ## Local Development See [`docs/LOCAL_DEVELOPMENT.md`](./docs/LOCAL_DEVELOPMENT.md). ## Contributing Creating clear issues is the best way to contribute. Read more here: [`docs/CONTRIBUTING.md`](./docs/CONTRIBUTING.md) We have this skill: `/simple-issue-description` which helps. ```sh npx skills add every-app/open-seo --skill simple-issue-description ``` ## Community Join Discord to chat: [Discord](https://discord.gg/c9uGs3cFXr) Follow along for updates: - Follow on X: https://x.com/bensenescu - Sign up for the mailing list on our website: [openseo.so](https://openseo.so)

aiSummary.oneLiner: Open-source, pay-as-you-go alternative to heavy SEO suites like Semrush and Ahrefs.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: OpenSEO is an all-in-one SEO tool designed for individual users and AI agents to perform focused search engine optimization workflows. Instead of locking users into expensive monthly subscriptions, it utilizes a bring-your-own-key model with DataForSEO to provide granular, pay-as-you-go data access. The platform features a modern web UI for tasks like keyword research, rank tracking, competitor insights, and backlink analysis. Crucially, it exposes a built-in Model Context Protocol server, allowing AI agents like Claude Code or OpenClaw to directly interact with live SEO data and execute pre-built agent skills. It supports both simple Docker deployments and advanced internet-facing Cloudflare setups for easy self-hosting.
keyFeatures: Pay-As-You-Go Architecture: Operates on a bring-your-own-key model using DataForSEO, eliminating expensive recurring subscriptions.
Native MCP Server: Exposes live SEO data directly to AI agents via the Model Context Protocol for automated workflows.
Comprehensive SEO Workflows: Includes dedicated tools for keyword research, backlink analysis, site audits, and rank tracking.
AI Agent Skills: Provides pre-built skills that guide compatible AI agents through complex SEO analysis tasks.
Flexible Self-Hosting: Supports local deployment via Docker or secure, internet-facing hosting using Cloudflare.

releases.name: v0.1.19
releases.body:
MCP sign-in for self-hosts with email and password accounts, and larger JavaScript-rendered audits.

## What's new

- Audits that render JavaScript are no longer capped at 1,000 pages

## Fixed

- MCP clients can finish signing in on self-hosts with email and password accounts, instead of stopping on "Not available".
- Rank tracking keywords added over MCP now show search volume, difficulty and CPC.

Full Changelog: https://github.com/every-app/open-seo/compare/v0.1.18...v0.1.19

releases.name: v0.1.17
releases.body:
Email and password accounts for self-hosting, and a new Docker setup.

## What's new

- Self-hosted installs now default to email and password accounts - existing installs keep their current sign-in.
  - Invite teammates from Team settings - you copy the link and send it yourself (no email).
- New Docker setup - the older image keeps getting updates.
  - Move to it with your data: see the [Docker guide](https://openseo.so/docs/self-hosting/docker)

Full Changelog: https://github.com/every-app/open-seo/compare/v0.1.16...v0.1.17

releases.name: v0.1.16
releases.body:
Site audit fixes for Shopify stores, Chinese and Japanese pages, and sites behind Cloudflare.

## Fixed

- Site audits of Shopify stores no longer stop when Shopify refuses a single page.
- Chinese, Japanese and Thai articles are no longer wrongly flagged as thin content.
- Email links on sites behind Cloudflare are no longer reported as broken.
- An audit that finds no issues now says so instead of asking you to run it again.
- Scanning your site from the dashboard no longer fails on Docker installs without `CONTEXT_API_KEY`.

Full Changelog: https://github.com/every-app/open-seo/compare/v0.1.15...v0.1.16

releases.name: v0.1.15
releases.body:
Search Console and GA4 setup over MCP, rank-grid maps in `local-seo` reports, and a way to disconnect agents.

## What's new

- Pick a project's Search Console site and GA4 property with MCP tools — thanks @ChNirvik
- Reports from the `local-seo` skill show the rank grid on a Google Map
  - Requires `GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY`
- Disconnect MCP agents in Settings → Connected agents
- Interactive Search Console and search results views in MCP clients that support them

## Fixed

- Running "Check rankings" rechecks keywords that have never ranked instead of saving them as "Not found" again.
- Prompt Tracking lets you pick any country, and grays out engines that can't collect there.
- Connecting Claude Code to OpenSEO no longer gets stuck on "Authorizing...".
- Search Console's "Last 7 days" and "Last 28 days" totals no longer count an extra day. — thanks @caelum0x
- An unverified DataForSEO account now shows how to fix it instead of "Something went wrong". — thanks @VodouAI

Full Changelog: https://github.com/every-app/open-seo/compare/v0.1.14...v0.1.15

readmeHtml:
OpenSEO

Open source alternative to Semrush and Ahrefs

OpenSEO is an SEO tool for the people. If tools like Semrush or Ahrefs are too expensive or bloated, OpenSEO is a pay-as-you-go alternative that you actually control.

All-in-one SEO tool for you and your AI agent.

Connect with any agent like Claude Code, OpenClaw or Hermes. We have pre-built skills, but you can build your own to tailor OpenSEO to your needs.

Hosted Version

Try OpenSEO for free on our website. If you want to support the project, a hosted subscription is $10/month.

openseo.so

EveryApp

Host OpenSEO and other open source apps on our platform EveryApp.

Self-host on EveryApp and give it a star →

Why use OpenSEO?

  • Best in class MCP and AI Skills.
  • Modern, simple UI.
    • Focused workflows instead of a bloated, complex SEO suite.
  • No subscriptions.
    • Bring your own DataForSEO API key and pay only for what you use.
  • Fork and vibe code your own custom tool.

Main SEO Workflows

  • Keyword research
  • Rank tracking
  • Competitor Insights
  • Backlinks
  • Site Audits
  • AI Visibility

OpenSEO MCP & Agent Skills

OpenSEO exposes an MCP server so AI agents like Claude Code, OpenClaw, and Hermes can use your SEO data directly. Agent Skills are reusable workflows that guide your agent through SEO tasks using the MCP.

  • Set up ChatGPT web or desktop (works on Free and paid ChatGPT plans)
  • Set up Codex
  • Set up OpenSEO MCP
  • Set up OpenSEO Agent Skills

Self-Hosting

OpenSEO supports two self-hosting paths. Both use email and password accounts: the first visitor creates the admin account, teammates join from invitation links, and MCP clients (Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, Cursor) sign in with the same accounts.

  • Docker - On your own server or computer, with a prebuilt image that is ready in seconds. Works with Compose-based platforms such as Coolify, Portainer and Dokploy. See docs/SELF_HOSTING_DOCKER.md.
    • Running the older single-container image? It keeps getting updates; move to the new setup when you are ready, data included.
  • Cloudflare - No server to run: one deploy command puts OpenSEO on your own Cloudflare account (works on the free plan). See docs/SELF_HOSTING_CLOUDFLARE.md.

For security-conscious setups, two advanced options replace the accounts with your own network controls:

  • Cloudflare Access in front of the Cloudflare deploy, so Cloudflare checks every request before it reaches OpenSEO. See docs/SELF_HOSTING_CLOUDFLARE.md.
  • No sign-in on Docker, behind Tailscale, a private network or your own authenticating proxy. See Without sign-in.

Either way, you need a DataForSEO API key to get SEO data. See docs/DATAFORSEO_API_KEY.md.

Costs

OpenSEO needs a DataForSEO API key so that you can get SEO data. You pay them directly when self hosting.

See openseo.so/pricing

When you self host, your costs will be slightly lower than the estimates on our website. The way the hosted service makes money is by charging 28% extra for every request we make to DataForSEO.

Local Development

See docs/LOCAL_DEVELOPMENT.md.

Contributing

Creating clear issues is the best way to contribute.

Read more here: docs/CONTRIBUTING.md

We have this skill: /simple-issue-description which helps.

npx skills add every-app/open-seo --skill simple-issue-description

Community

Join Discord to chat: Discord

Follow along for updates:

  • Follow on X: https://x.com/bensenescu
  • Sign up for the mailing list on our website: openseo.so
